research_question: Given a task and an available CapabilityIR table, can a dedicated resolver select the correct concrete capabilities, including deciding that no capability should be used?

inputs.training: data/compiler_corpus_v4/train.jsonl ONLY (tool-use records; canonical skills as input metadata)

leakage_rules: selected=true, reference actions, and future TaskIR nodes NEVER appear inside capability blocks
capability blocks carry only: capability_id, name, description, parameters, canonical_skill, skill_family

models.R2_pairwise_scorer: (task, capability) -> relevant | irrelevant, independent binary scoring, threshold selection (PRIMARY)

hard_negative_types: same_object_opposite_intent (get_order vs cancel_order; retrieval vs mutation on the same object)
negative_construction.hard_negative_types: hard negatives preferred from the record's real available set (incl. v4 distractor pool)
each negative tagged negative_type for failure analysis

none_supervision.construction: task paired with an available table from a different-domain record; label NONE
none_supervision.share: NONE is a Resolver decision, NOT a Skill ISA instruction

class_balance: positive:negative ~= 1:3 (hard negatives prioritized); effective distribution recorded
multi_capability: independent binary relevance (no top-1 softmax); inference = all pairs scoring>threshold; empty -> NONE
training: Qwen2.5-3B QLoRA r16 a32 lr1.5e-4 1 epoch; R2 pairs capped at 50k (record subsample if needed); R1 record-level
seeds: 42/43/44 for R2 (mean±std MANDATORY), 42 for R1 baseline
decision_rule: freeze R2 if R2 set-F1 > R1 AND exact-set > R1 AND NO_CALL F1 > R1
no_composer_chaining: 6B-2 trains/evals Resolver ONLY; chaining happens in 6B-3 after freeze
